summary.intent: Execute Session 6 of the LAUNCH-v1-alpha plan: work package S (Git boundary hardening) and begin T (recovery plan binding), pushing with an explicit refspec, verifying via git ls-remote, with no session trailers and never committing mutants.out*.
summary.outcome: WP S fixes were implemented and committed in a worktree (exact path bytes, literal pathspecs, NUL framing across vcs, apply, changeset_prs and release_decision), with an e2e QA-01 test and review fixes in a second commit. The final full gate was launched but its result was not recorded, and the push/ls-remote verification and WP T/V work had not happened yet.

repo: Git boundary code lives in callisto-model/src/vcs (access.rs, checkpoint.rs, tests.rs) and callisto-graph (apply.rs, changeset_prs.rs, commands/release_decision.rs, conventional/window.rs).
Raw `git add -- <path>` in apply.rs treated paths as globs, so `p/odd*/a` also staged `p/odd-other/a` into the version commit; literal pathspecs are needed.
Path output should strip only Git's line terminator, not whitespace (avoid stdout_trimmed for paths), and use -z/NUL framing for log, diff-tree and name-only output.
Fake-runner tests that emit newline-separated git output (window.rs, release_decision.rs fixtures) must be updated when switching to -z framing.
The installed `callisto` binary is 0.5.0, too old for this repo's config; use the workspace-built binary to write changesets.
A test environment script (env.sh) and a gate script (gate.sh) are used to run vcs tests and the full gate.

code.finding: The checkpoint trim was the root of the QA-01 bug; temporarily reverting it made the e2e resume test fail, confirming the test covers the fix.
The workspace prefix was trimmed in a way that broke odd paths, and commit_delta needed to move to diff-tree -z; fixtures had to be rewritten for NUL framing.

workflow: Write tests first and confirm they are red before implementing, then verify the e2e test fails with the fix reverted.
Per a worktree-guard memory, run multi-line git probes via script files rather than inline shell.
Run a fresh reviewer agent in parallel with the full gate; the reviewer surfaced additional -z siblings to fix.
Run cargo fmt before committing, since the first commit needed a reformat and re-commit.

friction: The first full gate failed with exit 101 due to a clippy lint in vcs/tests.rs and had to be rerun.
The worktree branch needed renaming several times (a repeated 'Rename worktree branch' step), suggesting the branch name reset or did not stick.
The installed callisto CLI version mismatch forced a fallback to the workspace binary.
The gate and reviewer ran in the background, requiring repeated notification polling and a TaskStop.
open_items: Result of the final full gate for WP S is unknown and must be checked.
Push WP S with HEAD:refs/heads/<branch> and verify with git ls-remote; this had not been done.
WP T (recovery plan binding) was only researched, with a binding test being drafted; not implemented.
WP V had not been started.
Ensure no mutants.out* files get committed and no session trailers are added.
